note: A select field used as an icon choice: the editor picks from a list, so a typo cannot produce an icon that does not exist.

data.heading: Built for editorial teams
data.intro: No shortcodes, no HTML in an editor field. Every component is a block with fields you can fill in without a manual.

items.title: Fields instead of markup
items.text: The editor knows the structure. Nested lists, repetitions and images are maintained as fields, not as HTML.

items.title: One output for everyone
items.text: Frontend and editor preview call the same PHP file. What stands in the editor is what gets delivered.

items.title: No fallbacks needed
items.text: Every value is escaped. A missing view is reported instead of silently rendering an empty area.

items.title: Semantic from the start
items.text: Definition lists for facts, details and summary for seasons, meter for ratings — operable by keyboard, without JavaScript.
